prompt_json.subject: AP Biology
prompt_json.capture_instruction: Original research seed for hand-drawn AP Biology graph-response grading. Do not expose criterion definitions to the person drawing the graph.
prompt_json.stem: Answer the following question. Submit one photograph showing your constructed graph and your written response together.
prompt_json.stimulus:
A botanist measured stomata density (per mm^2) on samples of sun leaves and shade leaves from the same tree species. Construct side-by-side boxplots from the five-number summaries, using one common scale. Then write one sentence comparing the centers and one sentence comparing the variability.

| Leaf type | Min | Q1 | Median | Q3 | Max |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sun | 180 | 210 | 235 | 260 | 290 |
| Shade | 90 | 110 | 130 | 150 | 175 |

criteria.learner_facing_text: Uses one interpretable common scale for both leaf types.
Both boxplots recover the listed five-number summaries.
Correctly compares medians (sun leaves have higher stomata density) in context.
Correctly compares IQR or range (sun leaves more variable) in context.

prompt_json.stimulus:
Researchers genotyped a beetle population before and after a pesticide was introduced. Complete a segmented bar graph using relative frequencies of each genotype for each time point. Then identify which time point has the larger relative frequency of the resistant (RR) genotype.

| Time point | RR | Rr | rr |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Before | 10 | 30 | 60 |
| After | 55 | 35 | 10 |

criteria.learner_facing_text: Converts counts to correct within-time-point relative frequencies.
Draws two complete segmented bars with total length 1 or 100%.
Genotype segments and time points are identifiable.
Correctly identifies After as having the larger RR relative frequency.

prompt_json.stimulus:
